log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

log_file.description: Name of the log file (relative to log_dir).

debug.description: Enable detailed debug logging for troubleshooting.

transport_url.description: Message broker connection URL (e.g., RabbitMQ, Redis).

api_paste_config.description: Path to the paste deploy configuration file.

host.description: IP address the API server binds to.

port.description: Port number the API server listens on.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for API connections.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if ssl_enabled is true).

project_name.description: Keystone project name for Masakari service user.

password.description: Password for the Masakari service user (securely manage in production).

keystone_authtoken.description: Keystone integration for API authentication and authorization.

lock_path.description: Path for lock files to coordinate concurrent operations.

workers.description: Number of worker processes for the API server.

endpoints.description: List of optional custom endpoint configurations (used by some deployments for extended services). Each item defines a named endpoint and its enabled status.
